propositions: Manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured (structured_run.py:87-178) must be replaced with a single Pydantic Agent operation composing the S1 output-policy adapter to preserve full history and maintain one shared request budget.

A HistoryProcessor wire-projection seam must include failed ModelResponses on the retry wire only when the full request plus output reserve provably fits within the model's context window, otherwise omit the response entirely while preserving it in all_messages().

The concision-aware guard must apply only to the PROMPTED output branch (TextOutput) with a read-only two-layer truncation check (finish_reason and provider_details), raising a bounded ModelRetry on truncation signals while delegating other cases to existing S1 classification logic.

The combined output-retry allowance (base + structured.OUTPUT_RETRIES) must seed both the operation-wide request_limit addend and the retries counter, ensuring the request budget cannot trip before the output-retry counter is exhausted.
Authoritative-input overflow (input_tokens + effective_max_tokens exceeding model window) must fail closed with ContextWindowExceededError with no content shortening, never proceeding to retry.

The NativeOutput branch must preserve its mode selection, run under the same bounded operation with pai_output.guard_capability() attached (not the concision guard), and keep truncation terminal without concision retry.
